tools.name: CodeGeeX
tools.description:
CodeGeeX is a powerful code assistant tool that utilizes a large-scale multilingual code generation model with 13 billion parameters. With support for over 15 programming languages, CodeGeeX can generate and translate code with ease. Its advanced features include pre-training on a large code corpus, making it an indispensable tool for developers looking to streamline their workflow and increase productivity. 

## Key Features
- Large-scale multilingual code generation model with 13 billion parameters
- Pre-trained on a large code corpus of more than 20 programming languages
- Supports 15+ programming languages for both code generation and translation

## Main Use Case
- Generate code in multiple programming languages with ease
- Translate code between different programming languages
- Streamline workflow and increase productivity for developers
